name: kivo-wise
description: WordPress on the Roots stack for AI assistants: detects Sage theme, Acorn mu-plugin or Radicle, routes to profile-aware skills, runs everything through Lando, reads official docs from a versioned corpus

interface.shortDescription: Roots stack (Sage, Acorn, Radicle) skills for AI-assisted WordPress development through Lando.
interface.longDescription: Skills, agents, slash commands and lifecycle hooks for WordPress on the Roots stack. Detects whether the project is a Sage theme, an Acorn mu-plugin or a Radicle application, routes to profile-aware skills, runs wp, composer and node tooling through Lando, and reads official documentation from a versioned corpus.
